quote: Yes, she thought, laying down her brush in extreme fatigue, I have had my vision.
source: Virginia Woolf, To the Lighthouse, Part III, section 14, the closing sentence (Lily Briscoe) (Hogarth Press, 1927)
speaker: Lily Briscoe
note: Corrected the locator. The Hogarth first edition of 1927 misnumbers the sections of The Lighthouse and prints the last one as 14; section XIII is the American numbering. The wording was checked against a scan of the Hogarth text and is unchanged.
